Description: Hardcoded absolute path to local git workspace in config/code/scripts
Author: casonk
Message:
feat: add stoplight signals and portfolio dashboard server

- stoplight.py: evaluates cpu/memory/disk/gpu against doseido-aligned
  thresholds, returns green/yellow/red per metric and an overall signal
- server.py: stdlib HTTP server; GET / renders gauge dashboard with
  colour-coded stoplight dots and progress bars; GET /api/status returns
  machine-readable JSON for downstream scheduler backoff decisions
- profile.py: expose latest_memory_total_bytes, latest_disk_total_bytes,
  latest_gpu_mem_total_mb from summarize_samples for ratio computation
- cli.py: add `serve` subcommand (--manifest / --port 5100)
- scripts/serve_tachometer.sh: convenience runner for the dashboard
- config/clockwork/portfolio-server.toml: simple systemd service unit
